frame: hall frame: metres, Y up, +x house right, +z toward the entry; rotations three.js Euler XYZ radians, a spot's unrotated beam points -Y; angle_rad = half the beam angle; box solids base-anchored; truss origin at the section centre, tower at the base plate (src/rigbuild/pieces.js), a tower's s[1] scales the 6 m catalogue tower.

crane_park.why: the near crane + the cut truss move inside it (another workflow, "half behind the DJ"): no unit above 2.5 m there and no beam through it

rules.glare_rule_status: ASSUMED: a design heuristic (forward scatter at HG g 0.74, HG(30 deg) ~ 1/5 of HG(15 deg); eyes.py), not a published standard. The eye-safety limit is the B380F's IEC 62471 hazard distance: UNKNOWN until the rental gives its risk group.

door_walk.why: the unpainted strip between the chill (x <= -8) and the bar (x >= 7) from the hot zone's end (z 43.5) to the door (z 53.8): everyone walks in here, so it is public

artists_route.why: ASSUMED: the artists' gate (x -2.4..2.4, MOXIR.md 4.0a) + 1.6 m each side, to the paint's far edge: kept clear of units and low beams

pit.why: MOXIR.md 5.3 "nothing on the floor between the PA and the barrier": from the PA boxes' front line (PA L 6.7) to the barrier (z 8.2), the barrier's width

rules.objective: sum over eyes (weighted by the people each stands for) and depth bins of sqrt(light): PAR lx from lit surfaces (Lambertian, one bounce, the crowd not see-through), beam G (single scattering, haze t40)

door_walkway.why: the unpainted strip between the chill (x <= -8) and the bar (x >= 7) from the hot zone's end (z 43.5) to the door (z 53.8): everyone walks in here, so it is public

public_floor.what: A2: the public floor = the paint (hot, wings, bar, chill) + the door walkway, less the stage pen and the machines; no unit and no barrier of this layer on it; no island

par_coverage.what: plan distance from every 1 m cell of the hot zone + wings (not the bar or chill zone) to the nearest hall PAR base, and (ground_pools) to the nearest PAR POOL (where its axis lands on the steel)

15.what: every floor PAR: its beam (15 deg + 1 deg aim tolerance, from its 0.10 m lens) between 1.5 and 1.9 m up to its first hit, against every public feet point 0.25 m apart; a person leaning 0.5 m

25.what: every floor PAR: its beam (25 deg + 1 deg aim tolerance, from its 0.10 m lens) between 1.5 and 1.9 m up to its first hit, against every public feet point 0.25 m apart; a person leaning 0.5 m

key.why: the gap between the PA boxes (x -6.5..-2.9), 1.71 m behind the barrier line (z 8.16: out of reach, ISO 13857 1.4 m), behind their front line: the only floor place that sees the DJ past both boxes

booth.why: the far corner of the gap between the PA boxes (x -6.5..-2.9), behind the PA boxes' front line (z 6.7: MOXIR.md 5.3, nothing between the PA and the barrier) and 1.61 m behind the barrier (out of reach, ISO 13857 1.4 m); its own lamp: from the floor the DJ face and the booth front are 14.7 deg apart, more than one 15 deg PAR holds

pa_faces.question: The PA boxes' faces: lit from the truss (another workflow), or the barrier moved 1 m out (z 9.2) so two floor PARs can stand at the pit's ends out of reach?

a_as_built.what: no floor PAR in the pit (MOXIR.md 5.3 holds); the faces get only what the rest of the rig gives

b_barrier_out.what: the barrier at z 9.2 (the pit 1 m deeper: the crowd-safety lead), round 1's pit-end lamps back (x -10.25 z 7.0, x 0.2 z 7.6): each face's lux at full from its own lamp
b_barrier_out.cost: the pit 1 m deeper over 13.6 m (~14 m2 of the dance floor), the barrier moved

stage_front.out_of_reach_rule: ISO 13857:2019 Table 2 (high risk): a 0.4-0.6 m high hazard behind a 1.0 m barrier, c = 1.4 m (as reproduced in the Troax Safety Guide; EQUIVALENT)

beam_field_glare.rule_status: ASSUMED: a design heuristic (forward scatter at HG g 0.74, HG(30 deg) ~ 1/5 of HG(15 deg); eyes.py), not a published standard. The eye-safety limit is the B380F's IEC 62471 hazard distance: UNKNOWN until the rental gives its risk group.
beam_field_glare.what: every public plan point (painted hot, wings, bar, chill + the door walkway; not the stage pen or a machine) every 0.5 m AND every point of the 0.5 m lean band outside its edge (0.25 m), eyes at 1.5/1.7/1.9 m (+0.6 on the FOH riser), every beam over its whole desk window (9 pans x 4 tilts), the angle at the head

rules.why: ASSUMED margins: no B380F ray within 1 m of a laser unit, no B380F end within 3 m of a block

bands.what: the entry end: the chill zone, the bar side, the door's flow
the back of the floor, FOH
the stage, backstage and the hot zone behind it (to z -31)

flagged_not_this_layer.the stage pen's own barrier (owed since: its back (z -7.5) and front (z 8.2, the crowd barrier) cross the strip x -10.75..-3.13 (limit 0.34 m): the laser lead (LSO) and the crowd-safety lead must accept them as unclimbable, or the strip moves

checks.level_law: linear: a fader at L draws L (the #868 fix); stage light computed with exponent 1

epic.what: [the spread, the ground] from the same nine eyes in the same hall (the fan's world: the crane park's air open); weights = the people each eye stands for (FIX 1); ratio = ground / spread

epic_peak_look.what: [the spread, the ground] from the same nine eyes in the same hall (the fan's world: the crane park's air open); weights = the people each eye stands for (FIX 1); ratio = ground / spread

epic_peak_equal_colours.what: [the spread, the ground] from the same nine eyes in the same hall (the fan's world: the crane park's air open); weights = the people each eye stands for (FIX 1); ratio = ground / spread

entry_gate.what: A5: each entry-side eye at the peak, ground / spread, at EQUAL COLOURS (level x light, the colour's luminance left out of both)

peak.why: the spread's stage key was ash: kept (a named few)
the spread's column washes were ember: kept
the cut (the truss workflow): ash in the spread, kept
the cut (the truss workflow): ash in the spread, kept

replaces the spread's 3 ASH roof PARs and its ember halo / stage columns: the roof and the walls are the hall's steel, so ember (the spread's split: steel in ember, ash only on the cut and a named few)
B's fan as the owner saw and kept it: ember in the spread too
the spread's wing beams were ash (its one cut-through colour in the hall): kept ash
NEW part (the spread had no beam at the entry end): ember, the hall's colour, so the ember split holds
the spread's stage key was ash: kept (a named few)

changed_vs_spread.why: the spread's stage key was ash: kept (a named few)

replaces the spread's 3 ASH roof PARs and its ember halo / stage columns: the roof and the walls are the hall's steel, so ember (the spread's split: steel in ember, ash only on the cut and a named few)
NEW part (the spread had no beam at the entry end): ember, the hall's colour, so the ember split holds
the spread's stage key was ash: kept (a named few)

palette.what: A3: every part of the peak look, its colour and level against the spread's same part (None = the spread has no such part); each change with its reason

headroom.glare_rule: ASSUMED: a design heuristic (forward scatter at HG g 0.74, HG(30 deg) ~ 1/5 of HG(15 deg); eyes.py), not a published standard. The eye-safety limit is the B380F's IEC 62471 hazard distance: UNKNOWN until the rental gives its risk group.
headroom.b380f_iec_62471: UNKNOWN: the rental (Poligraf) gives the risk group and the hazard distance; until then the 30 deg rule (ASSUMED), the line and the desk windows are the controls
headroom.what: A4: no beam or PAR part of any look above the cap (the laser part is the desk cap of the cubes, measured)

perimeter_line.type: a boundary line (not a crowd-pressure line): pedestrian barrier 1.1 m or fence (ASSUMED; the crowd-safety lead chooses); where a unit stands behind the public floor's edge within 6 m
perimeter_line.measure: the 1 m faces of the public floor's edge (a staircase: an upper bound, up to 1.41 x the straight line)

order.stage_pen_barrier_note: the stage pen's back and sides (the front is the existing crowd barrier at z 8.2) + A13's bay x -12..-10.5, z 1.75..6.5 (+3.0 m: its two ends; its outer side replaces the pen's side there): owed since the spread, not this layer's

floor_plates.what: 600 x 600 x 18 mm plywood, one per B380F (B's fan included)

sandbags.alternative: 4 x M10 concrete anchors through the plate, with the venue's written OK

cable_protectors.what: every metre of cable run over public floor (the union of all runs: power, DMX, feeders, network) under a cable protector; 1 m sections ASSUMED; 5-channel protectors carry several runs

stewards.basis: ASSUMED: one steward per area where the line stands (the Purple Guide is not read); the stage pen is crew (the stage manager)

order.public_floor_lost_why: no unit and no barrier of this layer stands on the public floor (A2)
order.par_fixing: each PAR stands on its own yoke on the floor, outside the line (no plate: no moving part; a cable tie to the line where one is near)

smoke_path.plan: the machine stands on the crew side (the stage pen); both 6 L tanks (running + spare) and the fluid are staged INSIDE the stage pen before doors, so a refill is a crew action from the back lane (x -10.5..1.5, z -7.5..-6.6) with no crossing of the crowd; the crew reach the pen by the artists' route (the crowd plan, owed)

bar_and_chill.question: Light on the bar and the chill + food zones (they are in your paint, marked bar / chill)?

a_as_built.what: no PAR pool and no beam end on the bar or the chill + food zone

b_allowed.what: the same pick with PAR pools allowed over the bar and the chill (beams still never end there)

pa_faces.question: The PA boxes' faces: lit from the truss (another workflow), or the barrier moved 1 m out (z 9.2) so two floor PARs can stand at the pit's ends out of reach?

a_as_built.what: no floor PAR in the pit (MOXIR.md 5.3 holds); the faces get only what the rest of the rig gives

b_barrier_out.what: the barrier at z 9.2 (the pit 1 m deeper: the crowd-safety lead), round 1's pit-end lamps back (x -10.25 z 7.0, x 0.2 z 7.6): each face's lux at full from its own lamp
b_barrier_out.cost: the pit 1 m deeper over 13.6 m (~14 m2 of the dance floor), the barrier moved

a5_island.question: A5: one island in the hall (A2 allows one, justified) so the beams reach the middle?

a_no_island.what: no island: every unit out of the crowd
a_no_island.why_not_met: no out-of-crowd place stands within 21.9 m of the painted cell x 3 z 19.5 (the nearest is 24.6 m away), so no pick from them meets 21.9 m

b_foh_island.what: one B380F on a fenced island beside the FOH riser (east of #873's strip), crew-only

bay.why: #878: the cut's low end (x -11.04, bottom chord 2.89 m) and its hl strap pass the pen's edge x -10.5 at 0.33 m over raised hands; with the bay fenced, 0.622 m (rule 0.5 m)

a13.cross_check: #878 reports 0.33 m (the truss) before and 0.622 m (the hl strap) after; here the truss is its bottom chord less half its 0.29 m section, the lamp bodies 0.20 m spheres (ASSUMED)
a13.what: A13: raised hands (2.5 m over every floor point outside the stage pen's barrier, 0.25 m grid, painted or not) to every part of the cut at z 3.20 (#878)

a14.what: A14: the 6 cube beams behind the stage (#878), padded by their 1.008 deg tube + 0.25 m + the ground beam's own half width; cable runs lie on the floor (y 0), 8.5 m under the volume

a15.what: A15: no ground beam on the near crane parked at z 3.20 (#878): girders z 3.2 +-1.1 (0.7 wide, 7.6-8.92 m, x +-11.35) or the cut (truss, picks, hl strap, lamps; + 0.3 m)
